mapper.select: SELECT m.MCHT_ID, m.MCHT_NM, m.SETTLE_CYCLE, pf.PM_CD, pf.FEE_RATE AS COST_RATE, sf.FEE_RATE AS SALES_RATE FROM SI_MCHT m JOIN SI_PTN_FEE pf ON pf.MCHT_ID = m.MCHT_ID AND pf.APPLY_DT = (SELECT MAX(x.APPLY_DT) FROM SI_PTN_FEE x WHERE x.MCHT_ID = pf.MCHT_ID AND x.PM_CD = pf.PM_CD AND x.APPLY_DT <= #{baseDt}) JOIN SI_STMT_FEE sf ON sf.MCHT_ID = m.MCHT_ID AND sf.PM_CD = pf.PM_CD AND sf.APPLY_DT = (SELECT MAX(y.APPLY_DT) FROM SI_STMT_FEE y WHERE y.MCHT_ID = sf.MCHT_ID AND y.PM_CD = sf.PM_CD AND y.APPLY_DT <= #{baseDt}) WHERE m.USE_FLG = 'Y'
SELECT MCHT_ID, MCHT_NM, SETTLE_CYCLE FROM SI_MCHT WHERE USE_FLG = 'Y' ORDER BY MCHT_ID
